text:
```yaml
name: autofix

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  autofix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build dist/
        run: npm run all

      - name: Apply autofix
        uses: autofix-ci/action@v1
```
